Indicator: Summary of the content moderation engaged in at the providers’ own initiative
Value:
Glassdoor moderates all user-generated content (UGC) at its own initiative. Two layers of automation technology screen the content of UGC for compliance with our Community Guidelines. If the UGC does not pass technological review, it is rejected and does not appear live on our services. If it passes technological review, it is made available on our services. If the technological review cannot determine if the UGC is compliant, the UGC is escalated for human review. Additionally, a human moderates UGC that is flagged for a secondary review by our users.

Prohibited types of content in UGC include: aggressive, offensive, or maliciously disrespectful material; targeted abuse; unwanted sexual content; insults; hateful speech; misinformation; trolling; privacy violations; impersonation; and proprietary or irrelevant information. Violent threats, incitement of violence, glorification of violence, slurs, trolling, and offensive stereotypes are also banned. Additionally, users cannot post photos that contain copyrighted content, nonpublic personal information, sexually explicit content, or workplace violations.

We also employ algorithms to detect abuse and gaming attempts. Submitting UGC requires email verification or the use of a verified third-party sign-on mechanism. In some cases, employment history verification may be requested. Enforcement actions include removing or restricting the visibility of UGC and temporarily or permanently suspending accounts from specific groups or the entire service.

Additionally, information is available in our Community Guidelines: https://help.glassdoor.com/s/article/Community-Guidelines?language=en_US

If the technological review cannot determine if the UGC is compliant, it is escalated for human review. During the reporting period, 68,781 UGC were removed by automation before ever appearing on our services, representing 3% of all UGC submitted and 36.5% of rejected UGC during the reporting period. Indicator: Qualitative description of indicators of accuracy and possible rate of error of automated means
Value:
Glassdoor calculated accuracy based on the sum of true positives and true negatives divided by total automated decisions. True positives represent the number of rejections of user-generated content (UGC) that were not later overturned by a human. True negatives represent the number of UGC approvals, where the approval was not later reversed and rejected based on human review.

Glassdoor calculated precision based on the sum of true positives divided by the sum of true positives plus false positives. False positives represent the number of UGC rejected by automation that were subsequently approved by a human.

Glassdoor calculated recall based on the sum of true positives divided by the sum of true positives and false negatives. False negatives represent the number of UGC that were not rejected by automation but were subsequently rejected by a human.

Indicator: Specification of the precise purposes to apply automated means
Value:
Glassdoor’s automated moderation is designed to detect and prevent the posting of user-generated content that violates our Community Guidelines (https://help.glassdoor.com/s/article/Community-Guidelines?language=en_US). Our Community Guidelines prohibit the following types of illegal, dangerous, and undesirable content in UGC including: aggressive, offensive, or maliciously disrespectful material; targeted abuse; unwanted sexual content; insults; hateful speech; misinformation; trolling; privacy violations; impersonation; and proprietary or irrelevant information. Violent threats, incitement of violence, glorification of violence, slurs, and offensive stereotypes are also banned. Additionally, users cannot post photos that contain copyrighted content, nonpublic personal information, sexually explicit content, or workplace violations.

We also employs algorithms to detect abuse and gaming attempts. Email verification or social media accounts are required to submit UGC. Employment history verification may be requested in some cases. Enforcement actions include removing or restricting the visibility of UGC and suspending accounts temporarily or permanently.

Indicator: Safeguards applied to the use of automated means
Value:
Human review and the ability of our users to flag content ensures that even if automation fails, there are additional opportunities for human review and remediation. 

Glassdoor allows all UGC to be flagged by our users for additional human review. Additionally, any user can contest a UGC-related decision and request that a human review their content for compliance with our Community Guidelines. Finally, we regularly review and adjust our automation to ensure it is meeting our requirements for ensuring compliance with our Community Guidelines.
